name: Mahou Senshi Next Ignition
original_name: 魔法戦士ネクストイグニッション
source:
In the past, Mahou Senshi (Magical Warriors) had fought against a sorcerer, Metzer Heinkel, who wished to conquered the worlds, and were able to protect peace by sealing him away. However, there was still someone who has planned to invade Earth again and has opened the new gate that connects the underworld and the terrestrial world. Mahou Senshi noticed the movement of their enemy and tried to intercept their plan. But due to the power of the gate they cannot use their powers properly.

Moreover, the monsters were also stronger. Hence, they lost to the monsters. To make things worse, people were convinced to go against the heroines and people were also starting to attack them. Amidst the troubles, the ones who helped the girls are their archenemies, Silva and Falke.

Silva and Falke joined force with Mahou Senshi to shut down the gate. Together, they were able to repel the monsters away. However, the two villains' reason of joining force lies somewhere else.

And that is to use the power of the gate to lift Metzer's seal. The undoing of the seal will be the beginning of their counter attack, the young girls' new battle has started....

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=924842]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
过去，魔法战士与一心想要征服世界的魔法师梅泽·亨克尔战斗，并通过封印他来保护和平。然而，仍然有人计划再次入侵地球，并打开了连接冥界和地上世界的新大门。魔法战士察觉到了敌人的动向，试图阻止他们的计划。但由于门的力量，他们无法正确使用自己的力量。

而且，怪物的实力也更强了。因此，他们输给了怪物。更糟糕的是，人们被说服去反对女主角，人们也开始攻击她们。在困境中，帮助女孩们的是她们的宿敌席尔瓦和法尔克。

席尔瓦和法尔克与魔法战士联手关闭了大门。他们齐心协力，击退了怪物。然而，两个恶棍联手的原因却另有其人。

而那就是利用大门的力量解除梅泽的封印。封印的解除将是她们逆袭的开始，少女们的新战斗已经开始……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=924842]Getchu[/url]]
